versions.content: The function FrIf_Init shall carry out the following actions: 1) Configure the FlexRay Interface module: initialize the local memory space used to store the PDU data and the PDU properties and state variables and the FlexRay Interface State Machine. 2) The initialization of the memory space has to make sure that the PDU-related static buffer status is set to "outdated"
